title: Code review and safe change 6
description: Use campaign.go to identify a bounded change, its callers, and a testable acceptance condition. Do not infer unobserved behavior.

learning_objectives.text: Explain the source role and visible behavior in campaign.go, campaign_test.go, main.go.
Trace a declaration, setting, or documented claim to a caller, test, or implementation path.
Separate source evidence, documentation claims, and unverified runtime behavior.

practical_outcomes: Evidence map for campaign.go, campaign_test.go, main.go
completion_criteria: Submit the code-trace exercise meeting all acceptance criteria.
